content.title: MasterBrand, American Woodmark to merge in $3.6 billion cabinetry deal
content.summary: NEW YORK (Reuters) -U.S. cabinetry manufacturers MasterBrand Inc and American Woodmark Corp said on Wednesday they will merge in an all-stock deal, creating a company worth $3.6 billion, including debt, amid consolidation in the highly fragmented building products sector.  American Woodmark's stock jumped 15% to $62 following the news, and MasterBrand rose 8.12% to $12.25 in afternoon trading.
